       Printable Voter FAQ 
       ✓ 
      How to Register to Vote
      You may register to vote at the Town Clerk's Office during regular
      business hours.
      The Supervisors of the Checklist also hold registration sessions
      periodically before elections. Registration-session dates will be
      published in the Portsmouth Herald and posted at Town Hall and on the
      Town website.
      You may also register at the polling place on Election Day, excluding
      Town and school deliberative sessions.
Who may register? 
      To vote in Greenland, you must be:
A United States citizen; 
At least 18 years old on Election Day; and 
A resident of the Town of Greenland. 
        NH Voter Registration Information
        Contact the Town Clerk
       ▣ 
      Registration Documents & Voter Identification
Documents needed to register 
      When registering to vote, you will need to provide proof of age,
      citizenship, residency, and identity.
      In many cases, a current and valid New Hampshire driver's license
      displaying a Greenland street address will satisfy these requirements.
      Other documents may be necessary depending upon your circumstances.
      A United States passport or naturalization papers may be used to prove
      citizenship. A utility bill, motor vehicle registration, or another
      acceptable document displaying your current Greenland street address may
      help establish residency.
       Unable to provide a required document? 
      Please speak with an election official. Affidavit procedures may be
      available under New Hampshire law.
Identification at the polls 
      Registered voters must present an approved form of identification when
      voting. Requirements for registering to vote are different from the
      identification requirements that apply to an already-registered voter
      receiving a ballot.
        Election Day Identification
        Registration Document Guidance
       📍 
      Where to Vote
      All Town and State elections in Greenland are held at:
       Greenland Central School 
      70 Post Road 
      Greenland, NH 03840
      Polling hours are  8:00 AM to 7:00 PM. 
      Town and School Deliberative Sessions are also held at Greenland Central
      School. Dates and times for deliberative sessions will be posted
      separately.
       ♿ 
      Accessible Voting
      Greenland Central School provides an accessible voting area for voters
      with mobility needs, including voters who use wheelchairs.
      Voters who require assistance or an accessible voting accommodation
      should speak with an election official upon arriving at the polling
      place.
        NH Accessible Voting Information
       ✉ 
      Absentee Voting
Who may vote absentee? 
      You may request an absentee ballot when you are unable to vote in person
      because of a qualifying reason under New Hampshire law, including certain
      work obligations, illness, injury, religious observance, disability, or
      absence from town during polling hours.
How to request a ballot 
      Contact the Town Clerk's Office to request an absentee ballot application.
      A written request must include the information required on the
      application, including your name, voting address, mailing address, and
      signature.
      A separate absentee ballot request is required for each election.
       Important:  Absentee voting rules and deadlines are
      established by state law. Review the current state instructions or
      contact the Town Clerk before submitting your request.
        Absentee Ballot Information & Application
        Email the Town Clerk
       ★ 
      Military & Overseas Voters
      A qualifying member of the uniformed services may apply for an absentee
      ballot through the clerk of the New Hampshire town or city where the
      voter was domiciled immediately before entering service.
      Qualifying military and overseas voters may use the Federal Post Card
      Application, commonly called the  FPCA , to register and
      request an absentee ballot.

      Frequently Asked Questions
         Where can I register to vote? 
            You may register at the Town Clerk's Office during regular business
            hours, at an announced session of the Supervisors of the Checklist,
            or at the polling place on Election Day. Election Day registration
            does not apply to Town and school deliberative sessions.
         Where do I vote? 
            All Town and State elections are held at Greenland Central School,
            70 Post Road. Polling hours are 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
         Who can vote in Greenland? 
            You must be a United States citizen, at least 18 years old on
            Election Day, and a resident of the Town of Greenland.
         What documents do I need to register? 
            You will be asked to provide proof of identity, age, United States
            citizenship, and Greenland residency. The documents needed depend
            upon your circumstances. Contact the Town Clerk with questions
            before visiting the office.
         Who is eligible to vote by absentee ballot? 
            Absentee voting is available to voters who cannot vote in person
            for a reason allowed under New Hampshire law. Review the current
            state instructions or contact the Town Clerk to determine whether
            you qualify.
         How do I obtain an absentee ballot? 
            Contact the Town Clerk's Office or use the current absentee ballot
            application provided by the New Hampshire Secretary of State.
         How do military and overseas voters participate? 
            Qualifying uniformed-service and overseas voters may register and
            request an absentee ballot using the Federal Post Card Application.
            See the Military & Overseas Voters section above for official
            forms and instructions.
